description: Reviews xcomm control-socket commands that act on a real serial device: text and bytes sent to the board (ctl send, ctl run), line control (break, DTR/RTS, line settings), zmodem/ymodem/xmodem transfers, and captures written to local files. Commands that only observe (ctl status, read, wait, sessions) are left unmatched. Opening a session directly (xcomm <device>, which also sends piped stdin and raises DTR/RTS) is outside this extension. Boundary reviewed against xcomm 0.1.3.
name: xcomm
saferAlternatives: Use xcomm ctl <device> read --since <offset> or wait to observe the board without sending anything.
Start the session with --ctl ro so the control socket allows status and reads only.
